note: Fixed price list used by the evaluator gateway. Cost = tokens x price below, regardless of what the provider actually bills, regardless of cache hits, and local models are priced as deepseek-v4.1-flash. Prices are per million tokens.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.source: Fitted from our own billing (300 answer calls, 2026-11-09): USD 0.18 / 0.72 per million tokens x 7.2. NOT an official list price; the owner does not know the official price. Replace when one is known.

qwen3.7-text-embedding.source: Owner-confirmed 2026-11-09: Bailian Qwen3.7 embedding is CNY 0.5 per million tokens.

qwen3.7-text-rerank.source: Owner-confirmed 2026-11-09: Bailian Qwen3.7 rerank is CNY 0.5 per million tokens.

qwen3.7-plus.source: Bailian list price, used only for question writing and review (not part of any system's cost). Owner to confirm.

qwen3.7-max.source: Bailian list price, used only for question review. Owner to confirm.

qwen-plus.source: Bailian list price. Owner to confirm.

qwen-max.source: Bailian list price. Owner to confirm.

memory_in_prompt_rule: Memory text placed into the answer prompt is charged at the flash input price. Its token count is prompt_tokens x (characters of memory text / characters of the whole prompt) from the answer call.
